scenario.title: Materialise dim_customers as a view instead of a table
scenario.description: Build cost disappears from the daily job, but every BI query and downstream model now recomputes the join. DAG-only estimators see a saving.

consumers.sql: select * from {{ ref('rpt_customer_segments') }} order by customer_count desc
select * from {{ ref('rpt_daily_kpis') }} order by ship_date
select nation_name, ship_month, sum(net_revenue) as net_revenue from {{ ref('mart_revenue_by_nation') }} group by 1, 2

main.name: dim_customers
main.sql:
select
    c.customer_key,
    c.customer_name,
    c.market_segment,
    c.account_balance,
    c.nation_name,
    c.region_name,
    coalesce(f.order_count, 0) as order_count,
    f.lifetime_value,
    f.avg_order_value,
    f.first_order_date,
    f.last_order_date,
    f.days_since_last_order
from "lab"."prod"."stg_customers" c
left join "lab"."prod"."customer_features" f on f.customer_key = c.customer_key

main.name: mart_revenue_by_nation
main.sql:
select
    c.nation_name,
    c.region_name,
    date_trunc('month', ol.ship_date) as ship_month,
    count(distinct ol.order_key)                    as order_count,
    sum(ol.net_revenue)                             as net_revenue
from "lab"."prod"."int_order_lines" ol
join "lab"."ci_main"."dim_customers" c on c.customer_key = ol.customer_key
group by 1, 2, 3
having date_trunc('month', ol.ship_date)
       >= date_trunc('month', 

    (cast('1998-08-02' as date) + cast(-3 as bigint) * interval 1 month))

main.name: rpt_customer_segments
main.sql:
select
    market_segment,
    nation_name,
    count(*)            as customer_count,
    avg(lifetime_value) as avg_lifetime_value,
    sum(order_count)    as order_count
from "lab"."ci_main"."dim_customers"
group by 1, 2

main.name: bi_segments_dashboard
main.sql: select * from "lab"."ci_main"."rpt_customer_segments" order by customer_count desc

main.name: bi_nation_trend
main.sql: select nation_name, ship_month, sum(net_revenue) as net_revenue from "lab"."ci_main"."mart_revenue_by_nation" group by 1, 2
